headline: As of 05:00: the internal CRM update passed its technical checks; a founder's hands-on test of the new Add screens is next.
items: The internal CRM update's technical run was accepted after security and quality reviews.
Saving new records stays switched on in the internal CRM, on the local machine only.
A founder's own hands-on test of the new Add screens is the last step before product acceptance.
The next update is being planned from the follow-up list found during the run.
Tech, Product and Data teams filed their Saturday status.
